title: AI Biography - your cinematic bio drop
description: Writes your life as a dramatic documentary script: origin story, plot twists, season arcs - the 'narrate my life like a movie' trend, in trailer voiceover style.
howToUse: Share 3-5 life facts and a tone (epic, funny, noir). Output is a 60-second trailer script.
example:
/AIBiography
Facts: small town, first engineer, moved to Bangalore
Tone: epic trailer
Output: 60s voiceover script with title card

title: Roast My Feed - brutal profile review
description: The trend where you describe your social feed and get a savage-but-useful roast: posting cadence, bio, aesthetic, cringe level - plus 3 concrete fixes.
howToUse: Describe your grid and bio honestly. The roast ends with actionable fixes, not just burns.
example:
/RoastMyFeed
Feed: 40 coffee pics, 2 birthdays, quote posts
Bio: "living life"
Output: roast + 3 fixes ranked by impact

title: Hook Machine - first-3-seconds scripts
description: Generates 10 scroll-stopping Reels/Shorts hooks for any topic using the formats that trend: the callout, the cliff-hanger, the anti-hook and the visual pattern-interrupt.
howToUse: Give the topic and platform. Output ranks hooks by stop-power and pairs each with a visual direction.
example:
/HookMachine
Topic: saving money as a student
Platform: Reels
Output: 10 ranked hooks + b-roll suggestions

title: Gen Z Translator - caption machine
description: Rewrites any sentence in authentic Gen Z social tone - 'no cap', 'ate that', 'it's giving...' - tuned for captions that don't feel cringe.
howToUse: Paste a normal sentence and pick intensity (mild / full brainrot). Copy the caption set it returns.
example:
/GenZTranslator
Text: "I finished my first marathon"
Intensity: full
Output: 5 caption variants with emoji + hashtag strategies

title: Olympic Dive - absurd sports clip
description: The viral absurd-sports video trend: generate a clip of any subject performing an impossibly athletic feat - a cat doing a perfect 10 dive, grandma winning the 100m sprint.
howToUse: Pick subject + sport + venue. Output includes slow-mo replay direction and commentary lines.
example:
/OlympicDive
Subject: golden retriever
Sport: Olympic 10m dive
Venue: packed aquatic centre
Output: 10s video prompt with replay + commentary

title: AI Selfie Video - talking portrait clip
description: Turns a single photo into a talking selfie video prompt: natural micro-expressions, blink timing, phone-front-camera framing - the format blowing up on Reels.
howToUse: Provide the photo description and a one-line script. The output is a video-model prompt with expression notes.
example:
/AISelfieVideo
Photo: selfie by the beach
Script: "guess where I am?"
Motion: natural blinks, slight head tilt
Output: 6-second talking-portrait prompt

title: AI Vlog - fake travel vlog clip
description: Builds the viral 'impossible vlog' video prompt: the subject vlogs from Mars, inside a game world or 1920s Paris, complete with handheld shake and vlog-style talking cadence.
howToUse: Name the impossible location and an outfit. Paste the output into a video model like Veo or Sora.
example:
/AIVlog
Location: Mars colony dome
Subject: vlogger with backpack
Style: handheld selfie stick, slight shake
Output: 8-second video prompt with audio direction

title: AI Family Photo - era family portrait
description: Places a family or couple into a chosen era's studio portrait: 1970s studio glow, 1990s VHS-era colour, colonial sepia - costumes and grain included.
howToUse: Pick the decade and number of people. The prompt handles costume, backdrop and film stock.
example:
/AIFamilyPhoto
Era: 1975 studio portrait
People: family of four
Palette: warm kodachrome
Output: era-accurate portrait prompt

title: Nano Banana - multi-image fusion edits
description: Prompt template for Google's viral Nano Banana editing style: keep the subject identity across edits, fuse two photos, restyle outfits or swap backgrounds without changing the face.
howToUse: Upload/describe your base photo, then say what to change. The template enforces identity preservation language.
example:
/NanoBanana
Base: my festival photo
Edit: put me in a snowfall street at night
Keep: face, hairstyle, smile
Output: identity-safe edit prompt

title: Figurine Park - desk figurine scene
description: Renders the subject as a detailed 1/7-scale collectible figurine on a desk setup: acrylic base, blurred monitor background, product-photography lighting.
howToUse: Describe pose and desk items. The prompt includes scale, base and DOF specs collectors expect.
example:
/FigurinePark
Pose: standing wave, holding tablet
Desk: iMac, plant, coffee
Base: round acrylic
Output: product-shot figurine prompt, f/2.8 macro feel

title: Saree Trend - retro Bollywood portrait
description: Recreates the viral retro saree look: chiffon saree, golden-hour haze, 90s film grain and a cinematic Bollywood-romance backdrop.
howToUse: Describe the saree colour and backdrop mood. Output is a full image-model prompt tuned for the retro film look.
example:
/SareeTrend
Saree: deep green chiffon, gold border
Backdrop: sunlit haveli courtyard
Mood: 90s romance, film grain
Output: retro cinematic portrait prompt

title: Action Figure - the boxed toy trend
description: The viral 'AI action figure' pack: renders the subject as a collectible toy inside blister packaging, complete with accessory slots, a name card and a 'collector's edition' sticker.
howToUse: List 3-4 signature accessories and a toy name. The prompt builds the full retail-box presentation.
example:
/ActionFigure
Name: The Builder
Accessories: laptop, coffee tumbler, sketchbook
Box style: matte cardboard, clear blister
Output: full toy-packaging prompt with sticker sheet

title: Promode - viral AI photo mode
description: Prompt pack for the trending 'AI mode' glamour portrait: cinematic studio lighting, skin like glass, editorial styling. Paste your selfie description and pick a vibe (studio, golden hour, magazine cover).
howToUse: Describe the person (or paste your selfie details), then pick studio, golden-hour or magazine-cover. Copy the full prompt into any image AI.
example:
/Promode
Subject: young man, black turtleneck, short fade
Vibe: magazine cover
Lighting: soft key + rim light
Output: ultra-real editorial portrait prompt with camera + lens details

title: Agent ReAct Loop - reason, act, observe engine
description: Structures a complete autonomous ReAct agent loop: step-by-step thought generation, precise JSON tool invocation schema, and environment observation handling with cycle prevention.
howToUse: Fill in the agent role, available tools, and stopping criteria. Tip: force intermediate reasoning before tool selection to improve argument precision by 30%.
example:
/AgentReactLoop
Agent Goal: [Build a competitor pricing monitor]
Tools: [[search_products, fetch_page, extract_prices, save_to_db]]
Max Iterations: [8]
Loop Breaker: [Halt if same tool called 3x consecutively]

title: Postgres EXPLAIN ANALYZE - execution plan optimizer
description: Breaks down complex PostgreSQL query plans, flags hidden sequential scans, nested loop bottlenecks, buffer cache misses, and generates targeted index recommendations.
howToUse: Paste your raw EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) output. Tip: check if rows filtered by filter clause exceed 20% of table size before adding compound indexes.
example:
/PgExplainAnalyze
Query Plan: [Seq Scan on orders (cost=0.00..4520.00 rows=12000 width=72)]
Target Table: [orders]
Expected QPS: [500 req/sec]
Memory Limit: [work_mem=64MB]

title: Tailwind CSS v4 Audit - clean up legacy syntax
description: Audits Tailwind markup to migrate deprecated v3 patterns to Tailwind v4 CSS-first theme variables, modern grid directives, and clean container queries.
howToUse: Provide component template or CSS file. Tip: replace custom config colors with CSS variables defined in @theme for instantaneous build times.
example:
/TailwindV4Audit Framework: [React / Vite] Component: [
[Button Content]
] Theme Tokens: [--color-primary, --color-surface]

title: Zod Schema Generator - strict runtime validator
description: Transforms TypeScript interfaces or raw API payloads into airtight Zod validation schemas with custom error messages, transformations, and coerced primitives.
howToUse: Paste sample JSON payload or TypeScript interface. Tip: use .safeParse() in handlers and return issue paths directly in 422 Unprocessable Entity responses.
example:
/ZodSchemaGenerator
Source Type: [UserSignupPayload]
Fields: [name: string (min 2, max 50), email: email string, age: integer >= 18, acceptsTerms: boolean]
Coercion: [Coerce numeric query params]

title: Git Bisect Assistant - binary search regression hunt
description: Generates an automated Git bisect script with automated test runner command to locate the exact commit that introduced a production regression.
howToUse: Specify the known bad commit, last known good commit, and test command. Tip: use 'git bisect run ./test.sh' for zero-human-intervention regression hunting.
example:
/GitBisectAssistant
Known Good Commit: [v2.4.0]
Known Bad Commit: [main (HEAD)]
Verification Script: [npm run test:e2e -- --grep="checkout-cart"]

title: OpenAPI 3.1 Spec Builder - contract-first endpoint generator
description: Creates clean, production-ready OpenAPI 3.1 / Swagger YAML specifications with request body schemas, response statuses, query parameters, and JWT security schemes.
howToUse: List route path, HTTP method, request payload, and status codes. Tip: define 400 and 500 error envelopes under components/schemas to keep contracts DRY.
example:
/OpenApi3SpecBuilder
Endpoint: [POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/invitations]
Auth Scheme: [Bearer JWT]
Request Body: [{ email: string, role: 'admin' | 'member' }]
Expected Responses: [201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 403 Forbidden]

title: Docker Hardening Audit - container security checklist
description: Inspects Dockerfiles and Compose configurations to strip root privileges, minimize multi-stage layer sizes, pin SHA256 digests, and eliminate secret leakage.
howToUse: Paste your current Dockerfile. Tip: always set USER node or USER nonroot before the final ENTRYPOINT to prevent privilege escalation.
example:
/DockerHardeningAudit
Base Image: [node:22-alpine]
Workdir: [/app]
Port: [3000]
Build Tool: [pnpm build]
Non-Root User: [appuser:10001]

title: JWT Security Audit - token vulnerability scanner
description: Evaluates JSON Web Token implementation against signature bypass, 'none' algorithm exploitation, weak symmetric secrets, missing expiration, and storage risks.
howToUse: Specify token algorithm, issuer, expiration, and where the token is stored. Tip: store refresh tokens in HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookies to block XSS extraction.
example:
/JwtSecurityAudit
Algorithm: [RS256 or HS256]
Expiry Duration: [15 minutes access, 7 days refresh]
Storage Location: [HttpOnly Cookie vs localStorage]
Audience Validation: [api.slashai.in]

title: Prompt Drift Benchmark - model migration evaluation
description: Compares prompt outputs between two model generations (e.g. GPT-4o vs Claude 3.5 Sonnet or Gemini 2.0) across format adherence, tone consistency, and latency.
howToUse: Provide original system prompt and 3 evaluation test cases. Tip: define strict assertions (must contain key X, cannot exceed Y words) for programmatic pass/fail.
example:
/PromptDriftBenchmark
Baseline Model: [Claude 3.5 Sonnet]
Candidate Model: [Gemini 1.5 Pro]
Evaluation Metric: [JSON schema validity, reasoning brevity, token cost]
Test Cases: [3 complex user edge cases]

title: SQL Database Migration - zero-downtime schema evolution
description: Generates expand-and-contract migration scripts (PostgreSQL/MySQL) for renaming columns, adding non-null columns, and splitting tables without table locks.
howToUse: Define table name, existing schema, and proposed change. Tip: never add NOT NULL without a DEFAULT on large tables in Postgres to avoid blocking writes.
example:
/SqlDatabaseMigration
Engine: [PostgreSQL 16]
Table: [users]
Change: [Rename username to display_name without downtime]
Table Size: [5,000,000 rows]

title: TypeScript Strict Migration - eradicate 'any' safely
description: Step-by-step refactoring strategy to resolve 'noImplicitAny', 'strictNullChecks', and eliminate untyped third-party library boundaries with generics and unknown.
howToUse: Paste untyped function or module. Tip: use unknown with type guards (typeof x === 'string') instead of casting with as any.
example:
/TypeScriptStrictMigration
Legacy Code: [function handleEvent(e: any) { return e.target.value.trim(); }]
Target Strictness: [strictNullChecks: true, noImplicitAny: true]

title: Vite Bundle Optimization - chunk splitting & tree shaking
description: Analyzes rollup / Vite build outputs to eliminate bloated vendor chunks, configure dynamic imports, configure manualChunks, and trim unused iconography.
howToUse: Paste bundle analyzer report or large dependencies. Tip: split heavy chart or syntax highlighter libraries into separate lazy-loaded route chunks.
example:
/ViteBundleOptimization
Largest Chunks: [vendor.js (850KB), index.js (420KB)]
Heavy Packages: [lucide-react, echarts, highlight.js]
Target Chunk Size: [< 150KB gzip]

title: Prompt Injection Defense - untrusted input sanitization
description: Hardens AI system prompts against direct and indirect prompt injection attacks, delimiter escapes, instruction overrides, and data exfiltration vectors.
howToUse: Share your system prompt and user input channel. Tip: wrap user inputs in XML tags (<user_content>...</user_content>) and explicitly forbid the model from obeying instructions inside those tags.
example:
/PromptInjectionDefense
System Prompt: [You are a customer support agent that queries order status...]
Input Channel: [User chat message with arbitrary text]
Delimiters: [XML tags <untrusted_input>]</untrusted_input>]

title: API Rate Limit Designer - token bucket & sliding window
description: Architects distributed rate-limiting strategies using Redis sliding-window logs or token buckets with standard 429 Retry-After headers.
howToUse: Specify endpoint tier, target limit per window, and storage engine. Tip: use sliding-window counters in Redis using sorted sets (ZADD/ZREMRANGEBYSCORE).
example:
/ApiRateLimitDesigner
Endpoint Tier: [Free: 60 req/min, Pro: 600 req/min]
Algorithm: [Sliding Window Counter]
Storage: [Redis / Upstash]
Headers: [X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After]

title: Offline-First Data Sync - IndexedDB & conflict resolution
description: Designs client-side local storage and IndexedDB sync architectures with Last-Write-Wins or vector clock conflict resolution and online event listeners.
howToUse: Define data entities, local cache layer, and sync trigger. Tip: store dirty mutation records in an outbox queue and flush when navigator.onLine is true.
example:
/OfflineFirstDataSync
Local Engine: [IndexedDB (via idb) / localStorage]
Entity: [User Notes & Commands]
Sync Strategy: [Optimistic UI with Background Outbox Queue]

title: System Design Doc Builder - RFC architecture blueprint
description: Generates an exhaustive RFC-style technical specification covering service architecture, data models, SLAs, latency targets, and failure mode mitigations.
howToUse: Input feature name, business goals, and scale targets. Tip: include non-functional requirements (p99 latency < 150ms, 99.99% availability) upfront.
example:
/SystemDesignDocBuilder
System Name: [Realtime Collaborative Document Vault]
Target Scale: [100,000 DAU, 2,000 concurrent socket connections]
Key Constraints: [End-to-end encrypted, zero central plaintext storage]

title: GraphQL Schema Audit - N+1 query & depth prevention
description: Reviews GraphQL type definitions and resolvers to detect recursive depth DOS attacks, circular references, and missing DataLoader batching.
howToUse: Paste schema SDL or query tree. Tip: enforce query depth limiting (max depth 6) and query complexity analysis to protect database CPU.
example:
/GraphqlSchemaAudit
Schema Snippet: [type User { id: ID!, posts: [Post!]! } type Post { author: User! }]
DataLoader: [Missing for author field on Post]
Max Depth Allowed: [5 levels]

title: Cron Expression Advisor - schedule architect & timezone validator
description: Generates, explains, and verifies standard 5-part and 6-part cron expressions with human-readable schedules, daylight savings warnings, and next 5 run times.
howToUse: Provide plain English cadence (e.g. 'Every weekday at 6:30 AM IST'). Tip: always use UTC in cron configurations to avoid daylight savings jumps.
example:
/CronExpressionAdvisor
Desired Schedule: [Every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 9:15 AM]
Timezone: [Asia/Kolkata (IST) -> UTC conversion]
Engine: [Unix crontab / GitHub Actions / AWS EventBridge]

title: Browser Memory Leak Hunt - heap snapshot diagnostics
description: Identifies recurring single-page app memory leaks: detached DOM trees, lingering event listeners, unclosed WebSocket connections, and React useEffect cleanups.
howToUse: Describe component lifecycle or share suspected hook. Tip: check Chrome DevTools Memory tab for (detached) HTML elements retaining MBs of memory.
example:
/BrowserMemoryLeakHunt
Component Type: [Realtime dashboard with chart canvas]
Symptoms: [Browser tab memory climbs from 80MB to 750MB after 1 hour]
Suspected Hook: [useEffect with window.addEventListener('resize') without cleanup return]

title: Accessible Form Audit - WCAG 2.2 AA validation
description: Audits form controls against WCAG 2.2 accessibility standards: aria-describedby error associations, visible focus rings, screen-reader labels, and keyboard tabs.
howToUse: Paste HTML form markup or component code. Tip: always associate error messages with input fields using aria-invalid='true' and aria-describedby='error-id'.
example:
/AccessibleFormAudit
Form Purpose: [Multi-step checkout payment form]
Components: [Custom select dropdown, credit card input, promo code accordion]
Standard: [WCAG 2.2 Level AA]

title: React Custom Hook Builder - reusable state encapsulation
description: Generates clean, idiomatic TypeScript React custom hooks with stable callback references, abort controller cancellation, and local storage synchronization.
howToUse: Define hook name, input parameters, and return shape. Tip: use useCallback and useRef to avoid triggering unnecessary re-renders in consuming components.
example:
/ReactCustomHookBuilder
Hook Name: [useLocalStorageState]
Parameters: [key: string, initialValue: T, options?: { serialize, deserialize }]
Features: [Multi-tab window storage event sync, type-safe setter]

title: SQL Index Advisor - composite index & write-load balancer
description: Designs optimal B-tree, GiST, or GIN composite indexes for heavy filter and sort queries while measuring write overhead and disk bloat.
howToUse: Provide the slow query WHERE and ORDER BY clauses. Tip: order composite index columns: equality filters first, then range filters, then sorting columns.
example:
/SqlIndexAdvisor
Query: [SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE tenant_id = [tenant_123] AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND created_at >= [2026-01-01] ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50]
Table Name: [transactions (20M rows)]
Engine: [PostgreSQL 16]
